A system of many agents, each producing deliverables under its own bounded context, will quickly and quietly drift in a dozen directions unless someone owns the standard of quality and has the authority to enforce it.
A principal runs a fleet of agents on many engagements at once, orchestrates the work, and governs it with isolation, permission, and audit.
